rules: The primary comparison contains the 81 original orderbooks under combined recovery and refurbishment. The unchanged frozen baseline product remains the control, with its case identities recorded without another 81 solves.

Six source-grade cases preserve each original orderbook and apply the previously defined poorer source grade/recovery coefficients. Six separate combined-rollout cases use the pinned humanities intervention orders. Failed capacity rows remain unresolved production.

Assets cover the 18 primary breakthrough/reference and breakthrough/wider cases only. Each physical solve supplies both the cash/material account and the actual full component cohorts, avoiding separate inconsistent solves.
Refurbished units replace retired units once. The restored service-potential stock is separate from procurement cash saved; no additional asset is created for an avoided purchase.

New-unit and repair-part quotes enter fabrication WIP. Retained-core service restoration enters only when the requalified unit commissions; it is a separate stock-reconciliation term, not cash profit or a market-price finding.

The previous undiscounted remaining-service proxy applies to commissioned units under the stated full-life requalification hypothesis. Repair labour, energy and consumables remain operating costs; this product does not additionally capitalize them.

Baseline seed averages are exact outputs of the inherited seed-stock calculation. Late years 6/7 feed is the frozen seed total minus that average feed. Its water/nitrogen/metal quantities have only coproduct-yield upper bounds; no exact late-product split is invented.
